value.title: The US launches another round of extensive strikes on Iran by May 18, 2027
value.text: By May 18, 2027 the United States carries out a new round of extensive strikes on Iran, of the kind the New York Times and Israel's Channel 12 report Trump is weighing (nuclear facilities, infrastructure, senior officials), as opposed to the limited strikes that have continued through November such as those on Qeshm island. The war began February 28, 2026; ceasefires in April and June broke down in July.
value.resolution_source: US government confirmation; consensus of major news reporting
